title: The Early Youth Engagement (EYE-2) intervention in first-episode psychosis services: pragmatic cluster randomised controlled trial and cost-effectiveness evaluation
cohort_overlap_notes: No other report of this cohort is in the batch. The trial is ISRCTN51629746; the protocol (Trials 2021;22:272) and SAP (Trials 2021;22:732) are cited but are separate publications and are not in the frozen screening set.
notes: Employment appears ONLY as Table 2's adjusted difference in mean days over 12 months, estimated on multiply-imputed data in the 232 of 1027 participants who consented to the societal cost-effectiveness interview. No employment count or prevalence exists anywhere in the report, so report_quantifiable = no. The Table 2 row is labelled 'Paid and unpaid employment', which is a broader construct than paid_any.

title: The association between early-onset schizophrenia with employment, income, education, and cohabitation status: nationwide study with 35 years of follow-up
cohort_overlap_notes: Danish national registers. Shares the source registers, but not necessarily participants, with other Danish register reports in the review (bonnesen2026 cross_tracks_dk, sturup2022). This cohort is a 1955-1991 birth cohort with a first schizophrenia diagnosis between ages 15 and 25, so overlap with a first-episode service cohort is possible but not established by either report.
notes: The Online Appendix (Tables 1-3) is cited in the Results and is NOT present in the 9-page PDF held in Data Extraction Papers/. The article itself prints absolute employment figures only as whole-number percentages in the text ('at the age of 25, 87% of the individuals with schizophrenia were not employed') and as an unlabelled line graph (Fig. 1, right panel). No numerator and no denominator appear anywhere in the held PDF, so report_quantifiable = no.

title: Employment Status and Personal Income Before and After Onset of a Severe Mental Disorder: A Case-Control Study
cohort_overlap_notes: ONE report describing THREE separately ascertained national case groups (schizophrenia F20; other nonaffective psychosis F22-F29; bipolar disorder F30-F31), each with its own separately drawn 1:5 matched control group. extraction_reports.csv holds only one cohort_id; report_cohort_map.csv is the authority and carries both psychosis cohorts. The bipolar group is not extracted (fails SAP section 7). No participant is in more than one group ('an individual was categorized only into one diagnostic group').
notes: Employment counts are printed for the diagnosis year (year 0) only: 'on average, 14% (N=968) of individuals with schizophrenia, 33% (N=11,335) of individuals with other nonaffective psychosis ... were employed' (Results, p. 251), against Table 1's year-0 denominators of 6,939 and 34,565. Every other year is a line in Figure 1 with no counts and is NOT extracted.

title: Impact of financial deprivation in first-episode psychosis: a prospective 4-year follow-up study
cohort_overlap_notes: Jockey Club Early Psychosis (JCEP) project, Hong Kong, recruited June 2009 to August 2011, aged 26-55. This is NOT the same cohort as hk_easy_2001 (EASY service, chan2019/chan2020/chan2022/chang2016 in batch F01): different service, different recruitment years and a non-overlapping age range, since JCEP was designed for adult-onset psychosis aged 26-55 while EASY served 15-25 year olds. The JCEP parent trial is Hui et al. Psychol Med 2023;53:2339-2351 (reference 28), which is not in this batch.
notes: The 4-year employment cell prints ONLY 'Unemployed, n (%) 40 (65.6%) / 21 (34.4%)'. Those percentages are ROW percentages of the 61 unemployed (40/61 = 65.6%, 21/61 = 34.4%), not column percentages of the group sizes 112 and 107, so the table supplies no evidence at all about the denominator on which the employment variable was observed. No employed count is printed at 4 years. report_quantifiable = no.

title: Efficacy of Individual Placement and Support (IPS) on Employment, Education, and Training in Young Adults With Early Psychosis—A Randomized Controlled Trial
source_filename: Brain and Behavior - 2025 - Jäckel - Efficacy of Individual Placement and Support  IPS  on Employment  Education  and.pdf
cohort_overlap_notes: Monocentre IPS trial at Vivantes Klinikum am Urban, Berlin (DRKS00018107). No other report of this cohort is in the batch or in data/.
notes: Counts are printed by allocated arm, but ONLY for the EET composite (competitive employment OR education OR training). Despite being an IPS trial, the report gives no arm-level competitive-employment count at 12 months: the employment subgroup analysis is reported as a chi-square with an odds ratio and no numerators. Every extracted result is therefore a composite, and none is paid_any.

title: Effectiveness of a community health worker-led case management programme to improve outcomes for people with psychotic disorders in Thailand: a one-year prospective cohort study
cohort_overlap_notes: One recruited cohort of 549. The early-stage and later-stage groups are a post-hoc split of that single sample on the number of past psychotic relapses, not two recruited samples, so they are subgroup arms and not two cohort_ids (D12.5).
notes: The one-year employment counts are in Table S3 of Additional file 1, which is NOT part of the 11-page article PDF and is not in dissertation_shared_folder/supplements/. Additional file 1 was retrieved during this extraction directly from the publisher CDN (https://static-content.springer.com/esm/art%3A10.1186%2Fs12888-022-03888-1/MediaObjects/12888_2022_3888_MOESM1_ESM.docx, HTTP 200, sha256 34ddddbbf0dc1d4e406298e0994c69e0c511b7d7ae1452de4fc101045d79f894) and every cell was read from it. It should be added to data/supplement_provenance.csv.
